mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_material WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_material_item i WHERE i.material_id=m.id) AS question_count FROM kb_material m
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_material SET title=#{title},description=#{description},kp_id=#{kpId},selection_mode=#{selectionMode},row_version=row_version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW(),remark=#{remark} WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT question_id FROM kb_material_item WHERE material_id=#{id} ORDER BY seq

SELECT r.source_id AS sourceId,r.note,s.title AS sourceTitle,s.extraction_status AS extractionStatus FROM kb_material_reference_source r JOIN kb_source s ON s.id=r.source_id WHERE r.material_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.source_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_product WHERE material_id=#{id}

SELECT qs.id FROM kb_question_source qs JOIN kb_source s ON s.id=qs.source_id JOIN kb_exam_source e ON e.source_id=qs.source_id JOIN kb_question q ON q.id=qs.question_id WHERE q.id=#{questionId} AND s.source_kind='EXAM' AND e.authenticity_status='VERIFIED' AND qs.match_status='VERIFIED' AND qs.matched_stem_hash=q.stem_hash AND qs.source_id IN #{sid} ORDER BY qs.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

when.foreach: SELECT s.id AS sourceId, s.title AS sourceTitle, q.id AS questionId, q.title AS questionTitle, qs.question_no AS questionNo, qs.page_from AS pageFrom, qs.page_to AS pageTo, #{point.kpId} AS kpId, #{point.kpName} AS kpName FROM kb_question_source qs JOIN kb_source s ON s.id=qs.source_id JOIN kb_exam_source e ON e.source_id=s.id JOIN kb_question q ON q.id=qs.question_id WHERE s.source_kind='EXAM' AND s.extraction_status != 'ORIGINAL_ONLY' AND e.authenticity_status='VERIFIED' AND qs.match_status='VERIFIED' AND qs.matched_stem_hash=q.stem_hash AND q.id IN #{questionId}

choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS sourceId, NULL AS sourceTitle, NULL AS questionId, NULL AS questionTitle, NULL AS questionNo, NULL AS pageFrom, NULL AS pageTo, NULL AS kpId, NULL AS kpName WHERE 1=0

mapper.select:
SELECT s.id AS sourceId, s.title AS sourceTitle, s.extraction_status AS extractionStatus, CASE WHEN s.extraction_status='ORIGINAL_ONLY' THEN 'ORIGINAL_ONLY' WHEN s.source_kind != 'EXAM' THEN 'NOT_EXAM' WHEN e.authenticity_status IS NULL OR e.authenticity_status != 'VERIFIED' THEN 'SOURCE_UNVERIFIED' WHEN 1=1 THEN 'NO_KNOWLEDGE_POINTS' WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kb_question_source qs JOIN kb_question q ON q.id=qs.question_id WHERE qs.source_id=s.id AND qs.match_status='VERIFIED' AND qs.matched_stem_hash=q.stem_hash ) THEN 'NO_VERIFIED_QUESTIONS' WHEN s.extraction_status='PARTIAL' THEN 'COMPARED_PARTIAL' ELSE 'COMPARED_EXTRACTED' END AS comparisonStatus FROM kb_source s LEFT JOIN kb_exam_source e ON e.source_id=s.id WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_source s WHERE 1=1
